40018207.author: पदार्थः
40018207.content: रुधिरक्लिन्नगात्रः body smeared with blood, शुभलक्षणः auspicious marks, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, आहवे in battle, तम् him, शक्रजेतारम् one who won Indra, हत्वा killing, हृष्टः joyful, बभूव experienced

40018207.author: Translation
40018207.content: Body having auspicious marks, smeared with blood, Lakshmana experienced the joy of having won Indra in battle.

40018208.author: पदार्थः
40018208.content: ततः then, वीर्यवान् valiant, महातेजाः mighty, सःलक्ष्मणः that Lakshmana, जाम्बवन्तम् Jambavantha, हनूमन्तं च and Hanumantha, सर्वान् all, तान् them, वनौकसः च Vanaras, संनिपत्य calling, ततः that, विभीषणम् Vibheeshana, हनूमन्तं च Hanuman, अवष्टभ्य following, सुग्रीवराघवौ Sugriva, Raghava यत्र there, शीघ्रम् quickly, आजगाम reached

40018208.author: Translation
40018208.content: Then Valiant and mighty Lakshmana called Jambavantha, Hanumantha, all the Vanaras, following Vibheeshana and Hanuman quickly reached Sugriva and Raghava.

40018209.author: पदार्थः
40018209.content: ततः then, वीर्यवान् valiant, महातेजाः mighty, सःलक्ष्मणः that Lakshmana, जाम्बवन्तम् Jambavantha, हनूमन्तं च and Hanumantha, सर्वान् all, तान् them, वनौकसः च Vanaras, संनिपत्य calling, ततः that, विभीषणम् Vibheeshana, हनूमन्तं च Hanuman, अवष्टभ्य following, सुग्रीवराघवौ Sugriva, Raghava यत्र there, शीघ्रम् quickly, आजगाम reached

40018209.author: Translation
40018209.content: Then Valiant and mighty Lakshmana called Jambavantha, Hanumantha, all the Vanaras, following Vibheeshana and Hanuman quickly reached Sugriva and Raghava.

40018210.author: पदार्थः
40018210.content: ततः thereafter, सौमित्रिःSaumihri, रामम् to Rama, अभिक्रम्य went close, अभिवाद्य च and offered his prayers, शक्रस्य Indra's, अनुजोयथा like his brother Upendra, भ्रातृसमीपस्थः close to his brother, तस्थौ stood

40018210.author: Translation
40018210.content: Thereafter Saumithri went close to Rama and offered prayers, like Indra's brother Upendra and stood close to his brother.

40018211.author: पदार्थः
40018211.content: तदा then, वीरः heroic, आगत्य coming close, महात्मने great soul, राघवाय to Raghava, निष्टनन्निव being tired in, इन्द्रजितःIndrajith, घोरम् terrific, वधम् killed, आचचक्षे reported

40018211.author: Translation
40018211.content: Then heroic Lakshmana coming close to the great selfRaghava, in shaking tone (being tired) reported" Indrajith is killed."

40018212.author: पदार्थः
40018212.content: तदा then, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, हृष्टः happy, महात्मना great self, लक्ष्मणेन by Lakshmana, रावणेः Ravana, शिरः head, छिन्नम् severed, रामाय to Rama, न्यवेदयत informed

40018212.author: Translation
40018212.content: Then Vibheeshana gladly informed Rama that Ravana's son's head had been severed by great Lakshmana.

40018213.author: पदार्थः
40018213.content: महावीर्यः great hero, लक्ष्मणेन by Lakshmana, इन्द्रजिद्वधम् Indrajith is killed, श्रुत्वैवतु on hearing, अतुलम् very, प्रहर्षम् glad, लेभेimmediately, इदम् this, वाक्यं च words, उवाच ह spoken

40018213.author: Translation
40018213.content: As soon as Lakshmana said that Indrajith was killed, Rama was very glad and immediately spoke as follows.

40018214.author: पदार्थः
40018214.content: लक्ष्मण Lakshmana, साधु well done, तुष्टः glad, अस्मि am, असुकरम् difficult, कर्म deed, कृतम् done, रावणेःIndarjith, विनाशेन by his fall, जितम् इति winning this, उपधारयhas been achieved

40018214.author: Translation
40018214.content: "Well done, Lakshmana! I am glad. A difficult deed has been done. By the fall of Indrajith success has been achieved."

40018215.author: पदार्थः
40018215.content: वीर्यवान् valiant, सःhe, कीर्तिवर्धनम् enhancer of glory, तंलक्ष्मणम् him, Lakshmana, शिरसि head, उपाघ्राय bending, लज्जमानम् shy, स्नेहात् lovingly, बलात् forcibly, अङ्कम्, आरोप्य drawing, भ्रातरम्brother, तंलक्ष्मणम् that Lakshmana, उत्सङ्गेlap, उपवेश्य making him sit, अवपीडतम् wounded, परिष्वज्य examining, स्निग्धम् red, पुनःपुनःagain and again, उदैक्षत looked at him

40018215.author: Translation
40018215.content: Bending the head of Lakshmana, a valiant one and enhancer of glory, who was shy of praising him, Rama lovingly, forcibly drawing him onto his lap and making him sit on examined again and again the wounded body and looked at him.

40018216.author: पदार्थः
40018216.content: वीर्यवान् valiant, सःhe, कीर्तिवर्धनम् enhancer of glory, तंलक्ष्मणम् him, Lakshmana, शिरसि head, उपाघ्राय bending, लज्जमानम् shy, स्नेहात् lovingly, बलात् forcibly, अङ्कम्, आरोप्य drawing, भ्रातरम्brother, तंलक्ष्मणम् that Lakshmana, उत्सङ्गेlap, उपवेश्य making him sit, अवपीडतम् wounded, परिष्वज्य examining, स्निग्धम् red, पुनःपुनःagain and again, उदैक्षत looked at him

40018216.author: Translation
40018216.content: Bending the head of Lakshmana, a valiant one and enhancer of glory, who was shy of praising him, Rama lovingly, forcibly drawing him onto his lap and making him sit on examined again and again the wounded body and looked at him.

40018217.author: पदार्थः
40018217.content: पुरुषर्षभः bull among men, शल्यसम्पीडितम् tormented body arrows, शस्तम् by arrows, निःश्वसन्तम् breathing heavily, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, दुःखसन्तप्तम् immersed in pain, निःश्वासपीडितम् breathing hard, तम् him, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, भूयःagain, संस्पृश्य stroking him, आश्वास्य restoring his confidence, त्वरन्quickly, वाक्यम् words, उवाच spoke

40018217.author: Translation
40018217.content: Lakshmana, a bull among men, body tormented by arrows, immersed in pain, breathing heavily. Rama stroking him, restoring his confidence, quickly spoke as follows.

40018218.author: पदार्थः
40018218.content: पुरुषर्षभः bull among men, शल्यसम्पीडितम् tormented body arrows, शस्तम् by arrows, निःश्वसन्तम् breathing heavily, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, दुःखसन्तप्तम् immersed in pain, निःश्वासपीडितम् breathing hard, तम् him, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, भूयःagain, संस्पृश्य stroking him, आश्वास्य restoring his confidence, त्वरन्quickly, वाक्यम् words, उवाच spoke

40018218.author: Translation
40018218.content: Lakshmana, a bull among men, body tormented by arrows, immersed in pain, breathing heavily. Rama stroking him, restoring his confidence, quickly spoke as follows.

40018219.author: पदार्थः
40018219.content: दुष्करकर्मणा one who does What is difficult for others, परमकळ्याणम् deed which is extremely auspicious (beneficial), कर्म action, कृतम् done, अद्य now, पुत्रे son, हते killed, युधि in battle, रावणम् Ravana, निहतम् also killed, मन्ये think

40018219.author: Translation
40018219.content: "You have done an extremely beneficial task which is difficult for others to do. I think Ravana is killed in the battle with your action of killing Indrajith."

40018220.author: पदार्थः
40018220.content: वीर hero, दुरात्मनि evil minded, तस्मिन् his, शत्रौ arrows, हते killed, अद्य now, अहम्I, विजयी victorious, रणे in battle, त्वया by you, दिष्ट्या, नृशंसस्य, रावणस्य Ravana's, दक्षिणःright, बाहुःhand, छिन्नोहि shattered, सः he, तस्य his, व्यपाश्रयःहि taking refuge, रणे in combat, विभीषणहनूमद्भ्याम् by Vibheeshana and Hanuman, महत् great, कर्म action, कृतम् was done

40018220.author: Translation
40018220.content: 'Ravana was depending on Indrajith indeed. Now by that a great action of severing his right hand in comb at by Vibheeshana and Hanuman, I consider victorious.'

40018221.author: पदार्थः
40018221.content: वीर hero, दुरात्मनि evil minded, तस्मिन् his, शत्रौ arrows, हते killed, अद्य now, अहम्I, विजयी victorious, रणे in battle, त्वया by you, दिष्ट्या, नृशंसस्य, रावणस्य Ravana's, दक्षिणःright, बाहुःhand, छिन्नोहि shattered, सः he, तस्य his, व्यपाश्रयःहि taking refuge, रणे in combat, विभीषणहनूमद्भ्याम् by Vibheeshana and Hanuman, महत् great, कर्म action, कृतम् was done

40018221.author: Translation
40018221.content: 'Ravana was depending on Indrajith indeed. Now by that a great action of severing his right hand in comb at by Vibheeshana and Hanuman, I consider victorious.'

40018222.author: पदार्थः
40018222.content: वीरः hero, त्रिभिः three, अहोरात्रैः nights, कथञ्चित् indeed, विनिपातितः made short, अद्य now, निरमित्रः rid of enemy, कृतःdoneअस्मि I, रावणः Ravana's, पुत्रम् son, निपातितम् made short, श्रुत्वा hearing, महता large, बलव्यूहेन army troop निर्यास्यतिहि will come and return

40018222.author: Translation
40018222.content: 'Hero! In three days and nights indeed, you have made short of Indrajith. Hearing that Ravana's son has been made short of, Ravana will come now with large army troops.'

40018223.author: पदार्थः
40018223.content: पुत्रवधसन्तप्तम् sad about son's death, निर्यान्तम् coming forth, दुर्जयम् difficult to win, तं him राक्षसाधिपम् Rakshasa Lord, महता huge, बलेन with army, आवृत्य turning towards, निहनिष्यामि will put an end to him

40018223.author: Translation
40018223.content: 'On hearing of his son's death, the Rakshasa Lord will come forth with a huge army. Turning towards him I will put an end to him.'

40018224.author: पदार्थः
40018224.content: लक्ष्मण Lakshmana, नाथेन protector, त्वया by you, आहवे myself, तस्मिन् your शक्रजेतरि Indra's enemy, हते killed, मे my, सीता Sita, पृथिवी च and earth also, दुष्प्रापा difficult, न not

40018224.author: Translation
40018224.content: Lakshmana, with you as my protector and Indra's enemy killed, neither Sita nor earth will be difficult to get back.

40018225.author: पदार्थः
40018225.content: राघवः Raghava, सःरामः that Rama, तंभ्रातरम् his brother, आश्वास्य restored confidence, परिष्वज्य च embraced, मुदितः happily, सुषेणम् Sushena, समाभाष्य inviting, इदम् thus, अब्रवीत् spoke

40018225.author: Translation
40018225.content: Rama, the celebrated scion of Raghu dynasty, restored the confidence of Lakshmana and embraced him happily. He invited Sushena and spoke as follows.

40018226.author: पदार्थः
40018226.content: महाप्राज्ञः very wise, मित्रवत्सलः loved by friends, सशल्यः those arrows, अयंसौमित्रिः this Saumithri, सुस्वस्थः paining, यथा like this, भवति you may, तथा that way, त्वम् you, समुपाचर treat him

40018226.author: Translation
40018226.content: "O very wise Sushena! Treat Saumithri in such a way that this Lakshmana, loved by friends pained by the arrows pierced, will be relieved."

40018227.author: पदार्थः
40018227.content: सविभीषणः that Vibheeshana, सौमित्रिः Saumithri, क्षिप्रम् quickly, विशल्यः, क्रियताम् be treated, ऋक्ष्वानरसैन्यानाम् army of Bears, द्रुमयोधिनाम् who fight with trees, शूराणाम् heroes, ये च they also, अन्ये others, अत्र there, युध्यन्ति in the battle, सशल्याः the arrows, तथा so also, व्रणिनः wounds, तेसर्वेऽपि of all also, तथा so also, प्रयत्नेन by effort, सुखिनः make happy, क्रियन्ताम् healed

40018227.author: Translation
40018227.content: "Let Vibheeshana and Saumithri be treated quickly. Let all the army of Bears and others who fought with trees, and the heroes be treated. Let all others who fought in the battlefield and wounded be also healed by your effort and make them happy."

40018228.author: पदार्थः
40018228.content: सविभीषणः that Vibheeshana, सौमित्रिः Saumithri, क्षिप्रम् quickly, विशल्यः, क्रियताम् be treated, ऋक्ष्वानरसैन्यानाम् army of Bears, द्रुमयोधिनाम् who fight with trees, शूराणाम् heroes, ये च they also, अन्ये others, अत्र there, युध्यन्ति in the battle, सशल्याः the arrows, तथा so also, व्रणिनः wounds, तेसर्वेऽपि of all also, तथा so also, प्रयत्नेन by effort, सुखिनः make happy, क्रियन्ताम् healed

40018228.author: Translation
40018228.content: "Let Vibheeshana and Saumithri be treated quickly. Let all the army of Bears and others who fought with trees, and the heroes be treated. Let all others who fought in the battlefield and wounded be also healed by your effort and make them happy."

40018229.author: पदार्थः
40018229.content: रामेण by Rama, एवम् in that way, उक्तः spoken, महात्मा great self, हरियूथपःVanara leader, सःसुषेणः that Sushena, लक्ष्मणाय to Lakshman, नस्तः through nose, परमौषधम् supreme medicine, ददौ gave

40018229.author: Translation
40018229.content: Spoken by Rama in that manner, the great Vanara leader, Sushena gave supreme medicine to Lakshman through his nose.

40018230.author: पदार्थः
40018230.content: सः he, तदा then, तस्य his, गन्धम् fragrance, आघ्राय breathing in, विशल्यः, निर्वेदनश्चैव freed from arrows, संरूढव्रणएव च rid of pain from wounds, समपद्यत restored to normal state

40018230.author: Translation
40018230.content: He then inhaled the fragrance and got freed from arrows, the pain of wounds and restored to normal state.

40018231.author: पदार्थः
40018231.content: तदा then, राघवाज्ञज्नाया by Rama's order, विभीषणमुखानाम् Vibheeshana and other leaders, सुहृदाम् friends, सर्ववानरमुख्यानाम् all Vanara leaders, चिकित्साम् having treated, अकरोत् performed

40018231.author: Translation
40018231.content: Then by Rama's order Vibheeshana and other friends and all Vanara leaders were healed.

40018232.author: पदार्थः
40018232.content: ततः then, सौमित्रिः Saumithri, हृतशल्यः freed from arrows, गतव्यथ: relieved from pain, विगतज्वरः anguish gone, क्षणेन in a moment, प्रकृतिम् nature, आपन्नः having restored, तत्र there, मुमुदे happy

40018232.author: Translation
40018232.content: Then Saumithri, freed from arrows, relieved from pain, anguish gone in a moment, and naturally restored, was happy.

40018233.author: पदार्थः
40018233.content: तदैव at that time, रामः Rama, तथा so also, प्लवगाधिपः monkey leader, विभीषणश्च at Vibheeshana, जाम्बवान् Jambavan, क्षपतिश्च with their, ससैन्याः with army, आरोगम् free from wounds, उथतितम् getting up, सौमित्रिम् Saumithri, आवेक्ष्य seeing, सुचिरम् long time, जहर्षिरे full of joy

40018233.author: Translation
40018233.content: At that time, Rama, also the monkey leader, and Vibheeshana, Jambavan with their army seeing Lakshmana getting up, free from wounds were full of joy.
